training: 256 SOL updates, balanced at 64 updates per predefined training case (seeds 0, 2, 3, 4). Independent shuffled window epochs; normalization fixed to case 0. Validate all 100 frames at updates 0, 64, 128, 192, 256; select the earliest minimum, including identity. Evaluate the selected model once on the held-out test trajectory.
loss_convention: Mean normalized loss over predicted frames 1–100; initial state excluded.
runtime_convention: Benchmark wall time includes imports, compilation, reference generation, audits, training, validation and testing. Package installation, queue time and plotting are excluded. Training and checkpoint validation are reported separately. CPU except PhiFlow on GPU; timings are not a hardware-controlled solver ranking.
limitations: Four training trajectories, one validation trajectory, one test trajectory and one network seed; no generalization proof.
Identity selection means no learned correction benefit, despite completing the full training budget.
PhiFlow semi-Lagrangian scalar mass drift remains a documented limitation.

recipe_comparison.comparison: Frozen singlecase shuffledcheckpoint256 versus predefined fourcase balancedmix256; samevalidation/test andnormalization seed0
recipe_comparison.metrics: Physical meanabsolute scalarerror andmean cellcenteredvectorvelocityerror acrosspredictedframes1..100andallcells. Normalizedloss also comparableafterfixedscalescheck.
